name: Mighty Arcade
author: Moby Pixel
description: Mighty Arcade is 18 music-making games each built around a generative sequencer. Chess, Solitaire, Retro Games and more. The board, cards, balls and baddies all work together to make music while you play.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp; the sound engine is Mighty Arp's
